title: nf-core/nidavellir pipeline parameters
description: Pipeline for FAIR training of bioimage deep learning models

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about bioimage samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: Provide a CSV samplesheet with columns `sample,image_path` and optional `omero_id`. See usage docs for examples.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

omero_host.description: OMERO server host or connection URI used for data upload.

omero_project.description: OMERO project identifier/name receiving imported images.

omero_dataset.description: OMERO dataset identifier/name receiving imported images.

omero_metadata_ns.description: OMERO metadata namespace used when annotating imported datasets.

omero_dry_run.description: Generate upload manifests without performing OMERO import when true.

workflow_track.description: Select which workflow track to run. Overrides --pipeline_track when set.

pipeline_track.description: Select which high-level workflow track to run.

data_storage_mode.description: Choose the data storage subworkflow mode: conversion only or full OMERO upload pipeline.

stage1_omero_query_scaffold_options.title: Training stage (1): OMERO query scaffold inputs
stage1_omero_query_scaffold_options.description: Scaffold-only metadata for stage (1) dataset discovery from OMERO. These fields are recorded for provenance and planning; no automated OMERO query execution is implemented yet.

training_stage1_omero_tags.description: Comma-separated OMERO tags to filter candidate training images during stage (1) planning (scaffold metadata only).
training_stage1_omero_tags.help_text: Example: tissue=liver,stain=dapi. Currently logged for scaffold provenance; query execution is not yet implemented.

training_stage1_omero_kv_filters.description: Path to JSON file containing key-value filter rules for stage (1) OMERO selection scaffold.

training_stage1_omero_server_ref.description: Human-readable OMERO server reference identifier for stage (1) planning records (for example prod-eu-omero).

stage2_parent_model_selection_options.title: Training stage (2): parent model selection
stage2_parent_model_selection_options.description: Scaffold metadata describing the parent model intended for transfer learning in stage (2). These parameters are not yet wired to a model download/execution module.

training_stage2_parent_model_id.description: BioImage Model Zoo model ID selected as parent model in stage (2) scaffold.

training_stage2_parent_model_doi.description: DOI of the parent model artifact for stage (2) provenance capture.

training_stage2_parent_model_uri.description: Direct URI for the parent model package (for example a model zoo resource URL).

training_stage2_parent_model_version.description: Optional version pin or digest for immutable parent model selection in stage (2) scaffold.

stage34_training_eval_scaffold_options.title: Training stages (3)/(4): training and evaluation scaffold metadata
stage34_training_eval_scaffold_options.description: Run-level metadata for planned cross-validation training and evaluation stages. Current training track implementation logs scaffold stages only and does not execute model training yet.

training_stage34_fold_count.description: Planned number of cross-validation folds for stages (3)/(4) scaffold metadata.

training_stage34_seed.description: Deterministic seed recorded for stage (3)/(4) scaffold configuration.

training_stage34_hyperparams_json.description: Path to JSON file containing planned model/training hyperparameters for scaffold documentation.

stage5_publication_options.title: Training stage (5): publication scaffold options
stage5_publication_options.description: Scaffold metadata for model publication targets. Stage (5) API calls are not implemented yet; fields are retained for FAIR planning and provenance.

training_stage5_target_collection.description: Target collection/project identifier for stage (5) publication planning.

training_stage5_target_account.description: Target account or owner identifier for publication endpoint selection in stage (5).

training_stage5_publication_metadata_jso.description: Path to JSON document with additional publication metadata supported by the target API (scaffold-only currently).

stage6_rocrate_metadata_options.title: Training stage (6): RO-Crate metadata
stage6_rocrate_metadata_options.description: RO-Crate metadata fields used by the stage (6) packaging scaffold. FAIR metadata generation is scaffolded; full artifact packaging automation is pending.

training_stage6_rocrate_creator.description: Creator name(s) to embed in stage (6) RO-Crate metadata.

training_stage6_rocrate_organization.description: Organization or affiliation captured in RO-Crate metadata.

training_stage6_rocrate_license.description: License identifier for stage (6) RO-Crate outputs (for example CC-BY-4.0).

training_stage6_rocrate_run_title.description: Human-readable title for this run in RO-Crate metadata records.
